title: Somatosensory evoked potentials in the human spinal cord to mixed and sensory nerve stimulation
description: Simultaneous electroencephalography (EEG), electrospinography (ESG), electroneurography (ENG) and electromyography (EMG) recordings from 26 participants, together with electrocardiographic and respiratory signals. Somatosensory evoked potentials were elicited by mixed nerve stimulation (median and tibial nerves) and sensory nerve stimulation of fingers and toes, alongside a resting-state condition with eyes open. ESG electrode positions are provided for each participant. The study was pre-registered on OSF.
methods_description: Nine recording conditions were acquired per participant: resting state with eyes open, mixed median nerve stimulation, mixed tibial nerve stimulation, sensory stimulation of the index finger, middle finger, both fingers simultaneously, first toe, second toe, and both toes simultaneously. Simultaneous EEG, ESG, ENG and EMG were recorded with ECG and respiratory signals. The EEG channel Fz was referenced to the right mastoid, and the ESG reference was the 6th thoracic vertebra.
